## Context

Many of these materials relate to Simon D. Halliday, "Data literacy in economic
development," *The Journal of Economic Education*, 50(3), 284-298, 2019.
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1080/00220485.2019.1618762).

## Class Context and Syllabus

- Syllabus for Economic Development: [PDF](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19LTRxGW6fYIELHWc9tzKhKDsAuzO0y9F/view).
- Solow Growth Model: [interactive](https://shalliday.shinyapps.io/solow_growth/).
